## What's free

Unlimited projects with no pausing; per project: 1 database, 3 buckets, 5 functions

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://appwrite.io/pricing> before relying on this.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
